create_image_buffer: create an ImageBuffer instance with camera endpoint names and an AgentFrameworkConfig
handle_model_image_input_event: handle a MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT event to store image data in the buffer
get_latest_images_map: get the latest images map as a dictionary of camera stream names to event deques
get_latest_image_timestamp: get the timestamp of the most recent image event across all camera streams
reset_latest_images_map: reset the latest images map to clear all stored image events
